title.zh: 💰 融资 |  Tether参投AI计算公司Tenstorrent 15亿美元E轮融资
title.en: 💰 融资 |  Tether参投AI计算公司Tenstorrent 15亿美元E轮融资

current_state.zh: AI compute company Tenstorrent closed a $1.5B Series E led by Trace Capital and Innovation X at a $6.2B valuation, with Tether Investments, Fidelity, Morgan Stanley, ARK Invest and others participating, to scale Galaxy server deployments for open-weight LLM and video-generation workloads and expand its AI/CPU IP licensing business.
